lines.name: Meridia's Order
lines.about: A mod-added story line in which you join Meridia's Order, a band of Meridia's followers led by High Priestess Alara, and work against a group of necromancers across Skyrim. It has twelve story quests that start at Meridia's Sanctum, two side quests along the way, and five quests for members of the Order once the story is done.

getIn.where: she comes up to you on her own once you're away from Meridia's Sanctum
getIn.how: Finish The Break of Dawn; Paladin Marith then approaches you and says High Priestess Alara wants to see you at Meridia's Sanctum.
needs: Finish The Break of Dawn (Meridia's quest for Dawnbreaker), which the game starts after a level-up

order.what: Meet High Priestess Alara at Meridia's Sanctum and kill the necromancer Malfyur the Unliving in Solitude.
Follow Alara to Meridia's Shrine and fight off the attackers there.
Find the Wood Elf Findar, held in the Dragonsreach Dungeon, and recover the staff Summoner's Demise from Golvunter.
order.where: Dragonsreach Dungeon, Whiterun; Golvunter, outside Riften

order.what: Arch-Paladin Laracin sends you undercover to a necromancer recruiter at Deep Moon Lookout and then into the Dark Dawn Sanctuary to learn their plans.
order.where: Deep Moon Lookout; Dark Dawn Sanctuary, next to Rannveig's Fast

order.what: A side quest inside Infiltration: do tasks for Reeshi, the Sanctuary Master, to win his favor.
order.where: Dark Dawn Sanctuary; Understone Keep, Markarth
order.needs: Get inside the Dark Dawn Sanctuary during Infiltration

order.what: Clear the Malevolent out of Fort Justice, an abandoned outpost in the Rift, and attend Acolyte Kariss' funeral.
order.where: Fort Justice, near Riften; Meridia's Sanctum

order.what: Find who wrote a letter to the Champion at the Old Hroldan Inn and hear what she knows.
Search for the Wood Elf Orthelos from the College of Winterhold to the road near Dawnstar and bring him to Initiate Garin.
order.where: College of Winterhold; the road near Dawnstar; Fort Justice

order.what: Find a way to destroy Fiya's pocket realm of Coldharbour, escape it and report to Alara.
A side quest inside the pocket realm: the Dremora Alzacar sends you to play Fiya's games.
order.needs: Enter the pocket realm in The Pocket Realm

order.quest: The Jester, In The Bedroom, With The Knife
order.what: A side quest inside the pocket realm: help The Jester turn Alzacar against Fiya.
order.needs: Enter the pocket realm in The Pocket Realm

order.what: Go with Alara to Hob's Fall Cave to stop Fiya's ritual, then return to Fort Justice.
order.where: Hob's Fall Cave, Winterhold; Fort Justice

order.what: Lead a mission to Riften with Paladin Asger to hear a noble who says he saw a warlock.
order.where: Mistveil Keep and the Ratway Warrens, Riften
order.needs: Offered by Paladin Asger at Fort Justice

order.what: Go with Initiate Garin to confront the leader of his old cult in Windhelm.
order.needs: Offered by Initiate Garin at Fort Justice

order.what: Help Arch-Paladin Laracin deal with the Vigilants of Stendarr at Stendarr's Beacon.
order.needs: Offered by Arch-Paladin Laracin at Fort Justice after a run-in with the Vigilants

order.what: Go with Acolyte Una on a journey of self-discovery to Meridia's Shrine and the Order's old Sanctum.
order.needs: Offered by Acolyte Una at Fort Justice

order.what: Get Initiate Valrar's family ring back from Dario in Riverwood without harming him.
order.needs: Offered by Initiate Valrar at Fort Justice

unsure.why: No level is given for any quest in the line; the opening needs The Break of Dawn, which the game starts on a level-up whose level isn't in these files. How long the line takes isn't in the records.

Marith's approach fires away from Meridia's Sanctum in a kind of place named only by a keyword these files don't spell out, and the Sanctum's door opens from an outdoor spot not tied to a hold or landmark.

unsure.field: order.Our Lady / Fort Justice / The Ritual
unsure.why: The journals read as if these open by themselves when the quest before ends; the scripts aren't in these files, so whether you must talk to Alara first isn't certain.

unsure.field: order.Champion's Choice / Repentance Upheld / Stendarr's Mercy / Finding Yourself / A Parting Gift
unsure.why: The conditions on the members' offers aren't in these files. The Ritual's closing journal entry points you to the Order's members, so they likely open after it, but this isn't confirmed.
Telling Garin you're ready sends you into Coldharbour; whether you can come back before finishing The Pocket Realm isn't in these files.
What decides whether Findar escapes or dies isn't in these files.
Adelaide is flagged essential though the quest asks you to kill her, and a 'reason with them' option is offered by the journal without showing where it leads.
The records have a good and a bad ending with Asger but don't say which choice leads to which.

Marith, Asger, Garin and Laracin are already listed as potential followers in their own records, so whether these quests are what let them follow you isn't shown. Several quest scripts hold armour and robes (Blessed Hood, Blessed Robes, Steel Plate Cuirass, Fine Quilted Clothes) that aren't shown going to you.

lines.name: Penitus Oculatus
lines.about: A mod-added line in which you join the Penitus Oculatus, the Empire's security force and the Emperor's bodyguards, and hunt down Dark Brotherhood members who are still at large. Commander Maro gives every mission from the Penitus Oculatus Outpost in Dragon Bridge: five story missions after joining, then five repeatable assignments.

getIn.where: the Penitus Oculatus Outpost in Dragon Bridge
getIn.how: Talk to Commander Maro and join the Penitus Oculatus; from then on you ask him for assignments.

order.what: Join the Penitus Oculatus through Commander Maro.
Maro's first assignment: deal with an escaped Dark Brotherhood assassin hiding at the Moorside Inn and learn where Cicero and Babette are.
Track down and kill Babette, then report to Maro.
order.where: where the intel from Unfinished Business points; Penitus Oculatus Outpost
order.needs: Learn where Babette is in Unfinished Business

order.what: Track down and kill Cicero, read his journal, then report to Maro.
order.where: where the intel from Unfinished Business points; Penitus Oculatus Outpost
order.needs: Learn where Cicero is in Unfinished Business

order.what: Use the passphrase from Cicero's journal to get into the Dawnstar Sanctuary, clear it out and read the Listener's Journal.
Kill Amaund Motierre at Volunruud and report to Maro.
A repeatable assignment from Maro: kill an escaped Dark Brotherhood assassin at a place named in your journal.
A repeatable assignment from Maro: kill three rogue Penitus Oculatus agents at a place named in your journal.
A repeatable assignment from Maro: take documents from a Thalmor agent without getting tangled up with the hold's authorities.
A repeatable assignment from Maro: kill a noble who is secretly working for the Aldmeri Dominion without getting tangled up with the hold's authorities.
A repeatable assignment from Maro: kill a Thalmor agent who is interfering with Penitus Oculatus operations.

options: Kill the assassin and search her body for intel
Let her defect, escort her to the outpost in Dragon Bridge and read the Listener's Orders she gives you; she later joins the agents in the Dawnstar Sanctuary

gives: Penitus Oculatus Cuirass, Bracers, Helmet and Boots, on joining
Gold from Commander Maro for each mission and assignment
Items the quest sets in the Dawnstar Sanctuary in A Nest of Vipers, among them Windshear, Nightweaver's Band, Firiniel's End and Muiri's Ring
closes: The Dark Brotherhood Defector, if you kill her in Unfinished Business
Babette dies in Bad Blood
Cicero dies in Fool's Errand
The Dark Brotherhood's Listener and five assassins in the Dawnstar Sanctuary are killed; Penitus Oculatus agents move in afterwards
Amaund Motierre dies in Loose Ends

unsure.why: No level is given for any quest in the line, and how long it takes isn't in the records.

The conditions on Maro's joining line aren't in these files. The mod has a 'Legion requirement met' setting that starts off, so joining may need something to do with the Imperial Legion; its jobs hunt 'escaped' Dark Brotherhood members, which suggests it expects the Brotherhood to have been destroyed. Neither is confirmed.
Commander Maro is a target in the Dark Brotherhood's own quests (To Kill an Empire, Hail Sithis!); how this line clashes with the Dark Brotherhood line isn't in the records.

unsure.field: order.Bad Blood / Fool's Errand / A Nest of Vipers / Loose Ends
unsure.why: No giver line or script that starts these is in these files; each is tied to the one before by its journal text. Whether A Nest of Vipers also needs Bad Blood done isn't shown, and where Babette and Cicero hide is filled in at run time.

Maro's offer lines for the five assignments are in the records but their conditions aren't, so it's not known whether they wait for the story missions. One of them shares the name Unfinished Business with the Moorside Inn mission.

The armour is held by the joining quest's script and is likely handed over on joining, not confirmed. Gold amounts aren't in these files. The Dawnstar Sanctuary items come from the quest's item slots; whether they're loot, on display or on a mannequin isn't shown.

lines.name: A Daedra's Best Friend
lines.about: A Daedric quest that starts in Falkreath, where the blacksmith Lod is offering a reward for a lost dog, and leads to the Daedric Prince Clavicus Vile's shrine. It is two quests long: a short lead-in in Falkreath, then the main quest at Haemar's Shame and Rimerock Burrow.

getIn.quest: Speak to Lod, Falkreath's blacksmith, about a dog he's looking for
getIn.who: a Falkreath gate guard (Imperial or Stormcloak, whoever holds Falkreath)
getIn.how: A guard outside Falkreath mentions that Lod the blacksmith is looking for a dog; talk to Lod, then look on the road outside town.

order.quest: Speak to Lod, Falkreath's blacksmith, about a dog he's looking for
order.what: Talk to Lod about his lost dog and look for it on the road outside Falkreath.
Help the talking dog Barbas get back to Clavicus Vile, which means fetching the Rueful Axe from Rimerock Burrow.
order.where: Haemar's Shame, Falkreath; Rimerock Burrow, Haafingar

options: Give the Rueful Axe to Clavicus Vile and receive the Masque of Clavicus Vile
Kill Barbas with the Rueful Axe and keep the axe

gives: Masque of Clavicus Vile, or the Rueful Axe: one or the other
closes: Barbas dies if you kill him with the Rueful Axe
You can't get both the Rueful Axe and the Masque of Clavicus Vile

unsure.why: No level is given for either quest, and how long the line takes isn't in the records.
The conditions on the guard's line (a level or anything else) aren't in these files; Requiem and Wintersun both edit the lead-in and what they changed isn't shown.

Barbas's offer line has no conditions in these files, so whether you can meet him without first hearing about Lod's dog isn't shown. Wintersun - Faiths of Skyrim edits the quest last and what it changed isn't shown.

lines.name: A Night To Remember
lines.about: A Daedric quest that starts when a stranger named Sam Guevenne challenges you to a drinking contest in an inn. After the contest you retrace the night across the Reach, Whiterun hold and Eastmarch; the line is two quests long, a short lead-in and the main quest.

getIn.quest: Participate in a drinking contest with Sam Guevenne
getIn.where: an inn; the records place him in The Bee and Barb in Riften
getIn.how: Talk to Sam Guevenne and take him up on his drinking contest.

order.quest: Participate in a drinking contest with Sam Guevenne
order.what: Take Sam Guevenne's drinking contest.
Wake in the Temple of Dibella in Markarth and follow what happened that night through Rorikstead, Whiterun and Witchmist Grove to Morvunskar.
order.where: Temple of Dibella, Markarth; Rorikstead; Whiterun; Witchmist Grove; Morvunskar

unsure.why: No level is given for either quest, and how long the line takes isn't in the records.
The lead-in can move Sam to an inn it picks; which inn, and what triggers it (for example a level), isn't in these files. The Bee and Barb is where he is placed before it fires.
Persuasion checks are tied to the quest's dialogue, so some steps may have a talk-your-way-out option; the records don't show which.
Nothing in the records shows anyone dying or anything being shut off by this line.

lines.name: Boethiah's Calling
lines.about: A Daedric quest for Boethiah that the game starts on a level-up, sending you to her shrine, the Sacellum of Boethiah in Eastmarch. The line holds the main quest, a road encounter that points to it, a follow-up order from Boethiah, and The Man in Black, a separate mod quest set around the same shrine.

getIn.who: no one: the game starts it on a level-up (a Boethiah cultist met on the road can also point you there)
getIn.how: Once the quest starts, travel to the Sacellum of Boethiah in Eastmarch and find the cult there.
needs: A level-up past a level the records don't give

order.what: Find the cult of Boethiah at the Sacellum of Boethiah and decide whether to make the sacrifice she asks for.
order.where: Shrine of Boethiah, Eastmarch; Knifepoint Ridge, Falkreath

order.what: Agree to escort the Dark Elf Rudin Filaro from the Braidwood Inn in Kynesgrove to a shrine in the mountains northeast of the village.
order.where: Braidwood Inn, Kynesgrove; Shrine of Boethiah; Knifepoint Ridge

order.what: A random road encounter with a Boethiah cultist that points you to Boethiah's Calling; it isn't a step in the story.
As Boethiah's champion, assassinate the Jarl of Solitude.
order.needs: Become Boethiah's champion in Boethiah's Calling

options: Lead someone onto the Pillar of Sacrifice and kill them, fight the cultists, then kill her old champion at Knifepoint Ridge and wear the Ebony Mail to become her champion
Refuse to sacrifice a follower; Boethiah curses you, and you can pray at a Shrine of Stendarr for the Gauntlets of the Crusader or visit Molag Bal's altar in Markarth for the Hands of Coldharbour

gives: Gauntlets of the Crusader (from Stendarr) or Hands of Coldharbour (from Molag Bal), if you refuse Boethiah
closes: The person you sacrifice dies
Elisif the Fair, Jarl of Solitude, if you carry out Boethiah's order
Refusing Boethiah lays Boethiah's Curse on you until a god lifts it
Rudin Filaro dies in The Man in Black, and Boethiah's old champion at Knifepoint Ridge is found dead there

unsure.why: The level that starts the quest isn't in these files, and how long the line takes isn't in the records.
Boethiah's Calling and The Man in Black both use Knifepoint Ridge and a Champion of Boethiah; the records don't show whether doing one blocks the other.

It has no start record and is tied to Boethiah's Calling only by its journal text. Boethiah's Calling holds an 'Elisif is essential' setting, so whether and when Elisif can die isn't clear. The records file this quest under Companions, which looks like a leftover label.
The refuse branch is added by The Choice Is Yours; the records show what it leads to but not the exact moment you refuse.
The Blade of Sacrifice is named by the quest script, but whether you keep it isn't confirmed.
Rudin Filaro's record is marked essential though the last objective is to kill him; the quest probably lifts that, but these files don't show it.
